_comment: Legacy Scoop manifest retained for historical distribution metadata. Do not import for local setup; provision tools machine-wide.

apps.Name: ninja
apps._purpose: Ninja build runner — default generator for all ExplorerLens CMake presets

apps.Name: nasm
apps._purpose: NASM assembler — required for dav1d and libjxl SIMD assembly

apps.Name: meson
apps._purpose: Meson build system — required by dav1d (AV1 decoder)

apps.Name: nuget
apps._purpose: NuGet package manager — WTL package for LENSManager

apps.Name: 7zip
apps._purpose: 7-Zip archive tool — used by build scripts for library extraction

apps.Name: sccache
apps._purpose: Compilation cache for MSVC cl.exe — speeds up incremental builds

apps.Name: wix
apps._purpose: WiX Toolset v3 — alternative MSI build path (WiX v6 preferred via dotnet tool)

apps.Name: cppcheck
apps._purpose: Static analysis for C++ — pre-commit quality check

apps.Name: delta
apps._purpose: Git diff pager — improved diff readability

usage.install_all: Unsupported for local setup; use machine-wide vendor installers or approved machine-scope package sources.
usage.install_missing: Unsupported for local setup; use machine-wide vendor installers or approved machine-scope package sources.
notes: Legacy reference only; do not use Scoop import commands for Windows 11 local development.
Install VS 18 2026 BuildTools (MSVC v145, cl.exe 19.50) machine-wide via the Visual Studio Installer.
Install WiX v6.0.2 machine-wide under C:\Program Files or C:\ProgramData; do not use the user .dotnet tool path.
Windows SDK 10.0.26100 is installed with VS BuildTools.
